name: @cc/dsh-project-state-panel
description: Project state panel: one read-only panel over the generated state projections with four modes — business requirements, the task board, the design map and tests/traceability — sharing one selection. It reads state/views/index.json and the state entity frontmatter; the design map mode mounts the designmap PageEditor full-height (always editable, full-screen), so it owns no geometry and writes nothing itself.
